name: @w6w-apps/wappalyzer
description: Look up the technologies behind any website, discover its subdomains, verify an email address, and build technographic lead lists.

w6w.longDescription:
Wappalyzer identifies the technologies used on public websites — CMSs, ecommerce platforms, analytics tools, web frameworks, CRMs, CDNs and more — and packages that data into lookup, technographic prospecting, enrichment and monitoring workflows.

The core of this app is the Lookup API: point it at up to ten URLs and get back the detected technology stack for each, either from Wappalyzer's own dataset (fast, cached) or from a fresh live crawl. Around that sit three more real, documented endpoints — subdomain discovery for mapping a company's web footprint, email verification for keeping bad addresses out of an outreach workflow, and lead lists for turning "which companies use Shopify" into a downloadable prospect set.

Every endpoint, field and header here — including the exact 403 behaviour, the credit-accounting headers on every response, and the async crawl/callback lifecycle — was verified against Wappalyzer's own published OpenAPI 3.1 contract and live probes against api.wappalyzer.com, not a third-party integration directory.
